brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu unveiled a map of the wider Middle East depicting the Rapid Support Forces, a Sudanese paramilitary group, as aligned with Israel and the United Arab Emirates, Middle East Eye reported. The map also showed the RSF backing separatist movements in the region.

The RSF faces accusations of atrocities in Sudan's ongoing conflict. Netanyahu's map representation suggests a strategic alignment between Israel, the UAE, and the paramilitary force, though the full context and timing of the map's presentation remain unclear.

title: Netanyahu map depicts RSF aligned with Israel and UAE
